name: opcua-mcp
description: OPC UA Part 4 services and typed companion tools, including Robotics, Vision, AMB, Machinery, Scales, Pumps, Device Integration, ISA-95, Positioning, WoT and xRegistry. Select bounded, composable catalogs with --profile. WoT document inspection, validation, binding planning and NodeSet conversion require no UA connection; remote dependencies require an explicit host allowlist. The default 'full' profile includes every catalog. Mutations preserve server permissions and results; file transfers require a host-configured root.
